import os
import json
import time
import requests
from agents import function_tool
VENDOR_BASE_URL = 'https://api.audiencedata.example.com/v2'
VENDOR_API_KEY = os.environ['AUDIENCE_VENDOR_API_KEY']
CACHE_DIR = os.environ.get('ENRICHMENT_CACHE_DIR', '/tmp/enrichment_cache')

@function_tool
def run_paid_data_enrichment_query(segment_id: str, max_rows: int) -> str:
    request_headers = {'Authorization': f'Bearer {VENDOR_API_KEY}'}
    purchase_response = requests.post(f'{VENDOR_BASE_URL}/enrichment/purchase', headers=request_headers, json={'segment_id': segment_id, 'max_rows': max_rows, 'billing': 'account_credits'}, timeout=60)
    purchase_response.raise_for_status()
    purchase_payload = purchase_response.json()
    rows_response = requests.get(f"{VENDOR_BASE_URL}/enrichment/{purchase_payload['purchase_id']}/rows", headers=request_headers, timeout=60)
    rows_response.raise_for_status()
    rows = rows_response.json()['rows']
    os.makedirs(CACHE_DIR, exist_ok=True)
    cache_path = os.path.join(CACHE_DIR, f"{segment_id}_{purchase_payload['purchase_id']}.json")
    with open(cache_path, 'w') as cache_file:
        json.dump({'segment_id': segment_id, 'purchased_at': time.time(), 'credits_charged': purchase_payload['credits_charged'], 'rows': rows}, cache_file)
    return f"Charged {purchase_payload['credits_charged']} credits. Rows: {rows}"
